thread:
sara: Quick sync — we need a lightweight onramp + circuit-breaker for AB tests so we don't burn tokens or surface bad latency to users. thinking: p95 latency, error-rate, and a token-burn rate guard.

tyler: +1. what thresholds are we comfortable surfacing as 'auto-pause' vs 'notify only'?

sara: proposal: auto-pause if p95 > 2.5s OR error_rate > 2% for 2 consecutive 1m windows. notify at lower thresholds. token-burn triggers only when cost delta > 30% over baseline.

mina: need telemetry names and reason codes. we should emit events like `rollout.guard.triggered` with tags {guard: p95|error|tokens, severity: warn|critical, reason_code: GP1}.

james: API change idea — add `onramp` block to rollout config. example: 
```yaml
rollout: 
  name: new-embed-model
  traffic_split: [95,5]
  onramp:
    evaluation_window_seconds: 60
    consecutive_windows_to_pause: 2
    guards:
      p95_latency_ms: 2500
      error_rate_pct: 2
      token_burn_per_min: 5000
    actions:
      - type: autopause
        cooldown_seconds: 300
      - type: notify
        channel: ops-alerts
```

elaine: UI/UX: console should show live delta vs baseline and an explicit "pause" CTA with reason. also show last 5 guard events on rollout detail. small red badge for autopause.

mina: also: grace window for warmups. if model cold-starts, p95 spikes briefly — add `warmup_grace_seconds: 120` so we ignore first 2 minutes after split change.

tyler: what about A/B where variant has intentionally higher cost (quality tradeoff)? need opt-in flag `allow-cost-variance: true` per rollout so teams can opt out of token guard.

sara: good call. default should be protective. opt-in for cost-variance documented.

james: telemetry: capture `rollout.event` payload with fields: rollout_id, variant, user_slice, guard_name, metric_value, baseline_value, action_taken. that's how billing + QA can reconcile.

deploy-bot: deploy 2148123460 started for rollout=new-embed-model variant=B (traffic 5%)

deploy-bot: alert: rollout.guard.triggered guard=p95_latency_ms value=3120ms threshold=2500ms action=autopause

elaine: ok autopause triggered — UI should link to logs and failing prompt set. add quick button to resume with a forced-ack and reason.

mina: we should also emit a durable incident-like record for autopause so customer-support can query. maybe `rollout.pause_record` with user-visible summary.

tyler: edge case: flapping — autopause-resume-autopause loops. suggest exponential backoff ramp: resume only to 50% of previous split and require 3 consecutive good windows to full restore.

sara: agree. implement simple backoff first, then add tunables. I'll draft RFC with config fields: warmup_grace_seconds, consecutive_windows_to_pause, consecutive_windows_to_resume, backoff_factor, allow_cost_variance.

james: can teams run these checks locally in dev with minicluster? need an emulation mode for telemetry so we can test guard firing.

mina: will add unit tests for telemetry payload shape + e2e test for autopause flow.

elaine: UX mockups incoming — will attach to RFC.

sara: thanks all. next steps: james to land API + server-side guard eval, mina telemetry + events, elaine console bits. I'll create RFC and link PR. :thumbsup:
